title: Velexis Amadeus account
caption: platform.amadeus_accounts.status, one account per environment (amadeus_accounts_environment_uq). While pending_verification the page refreshes every 5 s for up to 2 minutes.

states.label: pending_verification (Not verified)
states.detail: Verification job queued on the platform worker (token request to the host).

states.label: active
states.detail: OTAs on the shared account can search; offices assignable.

states.label: invalid_credentials
states.detail: `last_error` shows HTTP status and Amadeus code only. **Rotate secret** or **Edit details**.

states.label: disabled
states.detail: Every OTA on this shared account loses Amadeus access. **Verify and enable**.

transitions.label: Verify now / Rotate secret / new host or client id
